shadows.name: hero-left-plate
shadows.purpose: Decorative plate thickness; not general UI elevation.

motion.name: hero-action
motion.purpose: Action color, border and arrow transitions; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-reveal
motion.purpose: Title, support and actions after intro clears.

motion.name: hero-left-idle
motion.value: 13s ease-in-out infinite alternate; translateY(-2px) to translateY(3px)

motion.name: hero-right-idle
motion.value: 17s ease-in-out infinite alternate; translateY(2px) to translateY(-3px)
motion.purpose: Opposing right plate drift while active.

motion.name: hero-surface-idle
motion.value: 19s ease-in-out infinite alternate; translateY(0) to translateY(2px)

components.name: Hero briefing action
components.description: Visual sample of the existing briefing trigger; runtime behavior remains in the application.
components.css: .ds-hero-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;min-height:52px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:999px;font-family:var(--font,Manrope,sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;color:#f5f7fa;background:#126bff;border:1px solid #478bff;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(234 243 255 / 16%);transition:background-color 200ms ease,border-color 200ms ease}.ds-hero-primary span{line-height:1;transition:transform 200ms ease}.ds-hero-primary svg{display:block}.ds-hero-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #aacaff;outline-offset:5px}@media(hover:hover){.ds-hero-primary:hover{background:#2478ff}.ds-hero-primary:hover span{transform:translateX(3px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-hero-primary,.ds-hero-primary span{transition:none}.ds-hero-primary:hover span{transform:none}}

narrative.overview: This is a surface-scoped record of the implemented home Hero. It does not establish rules for the navbar, intro, Galaxy, Memphis, pricing, cases, or other sections.
dos: Do preserve the approved Hero copy, destinations, readable static state, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the foreground provenance with its shipping raster.
donts: Don't infer global rules or authorize changes to other surfaces from this document.
Don't reuse the service micro-label as a general eyebrow component; it is explicitly pinned content for this Hero.
